articles.title: Tehran strikes Iranian Kurdish base in Iraq with drones, report says
articles.summary:
Tehran strikes Iranian Kurdish base in Iraq with drones, report says

Iran's armed forces attacked bases belonging to an Iranian Kurdish opposition group in Iraq's Kurdistan region using drones, Mehr news agency reported.

"As part of a drone operation carried out by the Revolutionary Guards' ground forces, the headquarters of the terrorist and separatist group Komala, located in the Balisan region, was targeted last night," Mehr reported.

Earlier, Reuters reported that an explosive-laden drone attacked an Iranian Kurdish opposition camp northeast of Iraq's Erbil on Saturday night.

The semi-autonomous region hosts camps and bases belonging to several groups of Iranian Kurdish militants, which Iran has targeted repeatedly since the start of the Middle East war in February.

articles.title: Morning update
articles.summary:
Morning update

Good morning, Middle East Eye readers,

If you are just joining us, here are the key developments from across the region and beyond:

* Israeli forces have sealed off all entrances to Hebron in the occupied West Bank and forcibly displaced around 2,200 Palestinians from their homes.

* US President Donald Trump has said Washington could strike Iran "as soon as tomorrow", or reach a “big, beautiful” agreement with Tehran.

* The Saudi-led coalition says it has intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile and two drones launched by the Houthis towards Riyadh.

* The Israeli army has said Palestinians with work permits will be barred from settlements in the occupied West Bank, except industrial zones and other approved areas, on Sunday and Monday.

* Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) spokesman Hossein Mohebbi has warned that the US-Israeli war against Iran could have consequences beyond the country’s borders, Press TV reported on Saturday.

* The Houthis have renewed their warning to airlines, airport staff and travellers against using Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport.

* Thousands gathered in Tel Aviv on Saturday for a large anti-government demonstration, three days ahead of a general election widely viewed as a referendum on Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

* Russia’s embassy in Tehran has denied reports that its embassy staff and specialists working at the Bushehr nuclear power plant are preparing to leave Iran.

* An explosive-laden drone attacked an Iranian Kurdish opposition camp northeast of Iraq's Erbil on Saturday night, Reuters reported, citing security sources.

* Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has directed the judiciary to pursue compensation for "material and moral" damages caused by the US-Israeli war, state news agency IRNA reported.

* Iranian Speaker Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf will not attend the Brics parliamentary forum in New Delhi due to "certain unforeseen circumstances",  the Iranian embassy in India said on X.

articles.title: Russia denies plans to evacuate staff working at Iran's Bushehr nuclear plant
articles.summary:
Russia denies plans to evacuate staff working at Iran's Bushehr nuclear plant

Russia’s embassy in Tehran has denied reports that Russian embassy staff and specialists working at the Bushehr nuclear power plant are preparing to leave Iran.

“Neither embassy staff nor Russian specialists at the Bushehr nuclear power plant have any plans to evacuate. Work continues as normal,” the embassy said in a statement, dismissing reports to the contrary as “FAKES”.

Bushehr, Iran’s only operating nuclear power plant, has come under repeated attack during the ongoing US-Israeli war on Iran. Satellite imagery released in July showed damage inside the complex.

Marco Rubio urged Cubans seeking political change in their country to act, saying “now is the time” moments after Donald Trump told a Friday rally for candidates in south Florida that US warships could intervene in Cuba on their way back from the Iran war.

The US secretary of state, in his social media post addressed “to those who seek to create positive change”, urged Cubans to capitalize on Trump’s plans. “The disappointment of failed promises, corruption, and the privileged lives of only a few; seize this opportunity to create the change you desire through a discrete [sic] partnership with the CIA,” Rubio said.

archive.security_status_en: Houthi attacks and escalating tensions around the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea continue to paralyze critical shipping lanes and energy infrastructure. Oil markets are reacting with crude hitting five-month highs, while Europe faces record-low gas storage levels due to disrupted Qatari flows.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující útoky na energetickou infrastrukturu a lodní dopravu, což udrží ceny ropy a plynu na zvýšených úrovních. Bezpečnostní rizika v regionu Blízkého východu zůstanou kritická.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued attacks on energy infrastructure and shipping are expected to keep oil and gas prices elevated. Security risks in the Middle East region will remain critical.

archive.security_status_cs: Situace v oblasti Rudého moře a Perského zálivu zůstává kritická kvůli stupňujícím se útokům Houthiů na energetickou infrastrukturu a lodní dopravu. Rekordní počty útoků a zásahy saúdské infrastruktury vedou k dalším dodávkám paliva ze strategických rezerv a ohrožují globální námořní obchod.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf remains critical due to escalating Houthi attacks on energy infrastructure and commercial shipping. Record numbers of attacks and strikes on Saudi infrastructure are prompting further draws from strategic oil reserves and threatening global maritime trade.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat testování cenových maxim ropy a pokračující asymetrické útoky v regionu, což udrží globální trhy v silném napětí.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, testing of oil price highs and continued asymmetric attacks in the region can be expected, keeping global markets under intense pressure.

archive.security_status_cs: Situace v regionu zůstává vysoce nestabilní kvůli pokračujícím útokům Houthiů na strategická saúdská města a ropnou infrastrukturu, podpořeným eskalujícími hrozbami vůči americkým zájmům ze strany Íránu. Rostoucí náklady na tankery a přetrvávající napětí v oblasti Perského zálivu nadále narušují globální námořní obchod a energetické dodávky.
archive.security_status_en: The situation in the region remains highly unstable due to continued Houthi attacks on strategic Saudi cities and oil infrastructure, backed by escalating threats against US interests by Iran. Soaring tanker costs and persistent tension in the Persian Gulf continue to disrupt global maritime trade and energy supplies.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat udržení cen ropy na zvýšených úrovních a pokračující asymetrické útoky, které budou udržovat globální trhy v permanentním napětí.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, oil prices are expected to hold near elevated levels alongside continued asymmetric attacks, keeping global markets under persistent pressure.

archive.security_status_cs: Situace v oblasti Rudého moře a Blízkého východu zůstává kritická kvůli pokračujícím útokům Houthiů na civilní i vojenské cíle, včetně nedávných úderů na letiště a ropné infrastruktury. Rekordní sazby za tankery a ekologické havárie způsobené útoky na plavidla masivně narušují globální dodavatelské řetězce.
archive.security_status_en: The situation in the Red Sea and the Middle East remains critical due to ongoing Houthi attacks on civilian and military targets, including recent strikes on airports and oil infrastructure. Record tanker freight rates and ecological disasters caused by vessel strikes are massively disrupting global supply chains.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další růst cen ropy a udržení rekordních nákladů na námořní přepravu kvůli přetrvávajícím hrozbám asymetrických útoků.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further increases in oil prices and sustained record maritime shipping costs are expected due to persistent threats of asymmetric attacks.

archive.security_status_cs: Konflikt s Íránem podporovanými Houthi nadále eskaluje, přičemž probíhají útoky bezpilotními letouny a raketami na saúdská ropná zařízení a letiště. Tyto asymetrické útoky vedou k ropným skvrnám v regionu a nadále ochromují klíčové námořní trasy.
archive.security_status_en: The conflict involving Iran-backed Houthis continues to escalate, with drone and missile attacks targeting Saudi oil infrastructure and airports. These asymmetric attacks are causing regional oil spills and further crippling critical maritime trade routes.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat setrvání vysokých cen ropy a rekordních sazeb za přepravu v důsledku pokračujících vojenských střetů na Blízkém východě.
archive.forecast_en: High oil prices and record shipping rates are expected to persist over the coming days due to ongoing military clashes in the Middle East.
